actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The card's first model is the MJCF scene main.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco>'
The scene includes joint_position_actuation.xml, the joint position servos
The hand mount carries the free joint hand_base
The model sets the MuJoCo integration step to 0.008 s in its option element
The asset_class default sets ctrllimited and forcelimited on its actuators
The actuator section declares 20 general actuators, each with an explicit ctrlrange
The actuator comment says the ctrlranges follow Shadow's technical specification, page 8, except THJ0 whose sign is reversed in this config
The first actuator A_WRJ1 has ctrlrange -0.4887 to 0.1396 rad
The actuator A_FFJ2 has ctrlrange 0.0 to 1.5708 rad
The actuator A_THJ0 has ctrlrange -1.5708 to 0.0 rad
The hand chain is a tree of 24 hinge joints: WRJ1/WRJ0, FFJ0-FFJ3, MFJ0-MFJ3, RFJ0-RFJ3, LFJ0-LFJ4 and THJ0-THJ4
The wrist joint WRJ1 is a hinge with range -0.4887 to 0.218757 rad
The wrist joint WRJ0 is a hinge with range -0.8 to 0.4887 rad
The thumb joint THJ0 is a hinge with range -1.78625 to 0.104035 rad
ReachEnv loads the card's model as robot/shadowhand/main.xml
CubeEnv, the base of the dactyl cube environments, loads robot/shadowhand/main.xml

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates the MJCF deterministically from the reset state and the model has no random element, so one ctrl sequence and tick count repeat a trajectory; the package's fake backend is deterministic too, but its placeholder motion is not the engine's physics.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the served main.xml and its includes for the joint dimensions, the 20 actuator ctrlranges and the 0.008 s step, then moves each actuated hinge toward its control value; it computes no inertia, torque, contact, equality, tendon or actuator dynamics, so no trajectory here is a MuJoCo result
the four tendon-driven actuators (A_FFJ1, A_MFJ1, A_RFJ1 and A_LFJ1) name a fixed tendon rather than a joint; the stand-in moves no joint for them and resolves no tendon
the stand-in loads no mesh or texture and does not resolve the mesh paths of assets.xml (for example robot/shadowhand/forearm_electric.stl relative to the robogym asset root), so nothing is rendered
the hand base is a free joint; the stand-in resets qpos to zero instead of MuJoCo's qpos0 and does not integrate a free body
the dactyl environments compose this hand model with a cube, target and table scene (cube_env.py:151); the driver serves the card's hand scene alone, not an environment scene
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so the engine path (backend sim) and the robogym asset search path were never exercised
no physical ShadowHand is modelled and nothing was validated against the hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
